purpose: Teach: 棺/鱗/葡萄/シルクロード/ラベンダー/眼科/苗字/ピストル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの遺品を棺の中に納めたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, we placed your father's things in the coffin.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Opening word carries the weight of time passed. Measured pace. Voice trails slightly, as if checking whether the memory is real or fading. Shoulder settles back.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お魚の鱗を取るのが上手かったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your grandfather was so good at cleaning fish scales, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm, tender correction that is also a gentle redirection. Slight lilt of recognition mixed with affection. She's offering her own memory as a gift back. Voice stays close and familiar.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが葡萄畑を持っていらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father had a grape vineyard.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before, but slightly more present in the telling. Opening attack is quiet, thoughtful. Slower cadence on the image of the vineyard. A small pause after—as if he's inside the memory looking around.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、シルクロードの本を集められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, your grandfather collected books about the Silk Road, remember?
lines.style: Gentle, persistent warmth. She's not contradicting—she's lovingly insisting on her own version of him. Voice carries slight musical lilt of storytelling. Final word rises slightly, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お母様がラベンダーの香りを愛されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your mother loved the scent of lavender so much.
lines.style: Voice softens further, more intimate. Opening attack vulnerable but steady. Word 'lavender' receives the most breath and care. Long, slow exhalation at the end. He's sharing something tender and specific.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、眼科に長く通われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather visited the eye doctor for so many years, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, knowing tone—she's building her own archaeology of him. Slight hum of recognition in her voice. Gentle pause after the question, leaving space for him to sit with it. Final lilt is affectionate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと珍しい苗字のご家族と親しくしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father was close with a family who had such an unusual surname.
lines.style: Opening attack quieter this time—almost a whisper of a memory. Word 'unusual' lingers slightly. Pace becomes deliberate, careful. Voice trails at the end, uncertain, like he's reaching for the name and can't quite find it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ピストル射撃のお話をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, didn't you once tell me stories about pistol shooting when you were young?
lines.style: Warm, close, slightly playful. She's caught him in a specific thread of memory. Voice leans in with intimate curiosity. Final words carry gentle teasing affection—she remembers his stories. Breath stays soft and connected.
